Team dossier Operation Slow, Unsure, Disoriented

Silver Bullets

The only bullet that needs directions.

Team color
Silver
Threat level
Low velocity, high laundry
Catnip & Hairball
3 hairballs · 1 catnip

Known for

  • A clothesline of unidentified laundry hung at their home during the football game (PNN-005).
  • A poster calling them 'Slow, Unsure, and Completely Disoriented.'
  • A flagpole that was never asked to do anything.
  • A name that suggests werewolf-slayers and a record that suggests laundry.

The file

The Silver Bullets chose a name meant to be fast, shiny, and fatal to monsters. PNN has yet to see any of the three. In PNN-005 the Pyro Posse hung a clothesline of charred, unidentified laundry on their lawn while they were away at football games, and the Bullets, to their credit, have still not identified it. Nobody has. The laundry has issued no statement. Neither has the Posse.

The poster at the Bullets' door read 'Slow, Unsure, and Completely Disoriented.' A bullet that is slow, unsure, and disoriented is, ballistically, a pebble. This is not an insult. It is physics.

The Silver Bullets also own a flagpole. As far as PNN can tell, it has been used for nothing. A flagpole is the one structure on Earth built to hoist things where the whole neighborhood can salute them. The Posse hung the laundry low instead, which the flagpole took personally.

In fairness, being pranked while you are out at a game is the best possible reason to be disoriented. The Bullets were at the stadium and got blitzed at home. That is not slow. That is football.

Strengths

  • A strong, shiny name.
  • A flagpole, unused but loyal.
  • An alibi so airtight it was literally a football game.

Weaknesses

  • Velocity.
  • Orientation.
  • Knowing what is on their own clothesline.

Clueso's advice

Hoist something. Anything. The flagpole has been waiting a very long time.

— Inspector Clueso, PNN
